abstract: Connect OpenAI's Codex CLI to self-hosted and gateway models over the Responses API. Covers install and updates, config.toml model_providers with base_url, env_key or auth commands and wire_api responses, profiles and --oss, per-engine setup for vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, llama-swap and LiteLLM, context window and compaction limits, reasoning settings, known compatibility issues with non-OpenAI backends (MCP, history items, tool calls, streaming), troubleshooting, and an endpoint probe script.
